name: Aleph Void Custom FW
description: From-scratch aggregate of both Aleph Void feature sets: each of the four tracks runs either a Euclidean rhythm sequencer lane or a tempo-synced LFO, toggled per track with SHIFT+track and locked to one shared 24 PPQN transport with MIDI clock sync in/out, full project management over the 64 saved-project slots, SPI-flash settings persistence and the complete VUP self-updater.
